android.desc:
🍅 PomoPlan: Pomodoro Timer, Task Manager & Habit Tracker

PomoPlan brings your Pomodoro timer, to-do list, and habit tracker into a single app that works completely offline.

Your data stays on your phone. You don't need to create an account, we don't track your tasks on external servers, and you can back up your database directly to your own Google Drive whenever you choose.

─────────────────────────
⏱ POMODORO TIMER
─────────────────────────
• Customizable focus, short break & long break durations
• Floating timer overlay — stays on top of any app
• Live notification controls: Pause, Skip, Reset without unlocking
• Tracks completed Pomodoros per task automatically
• Smart background timer — accurate even when your screen is off
• Screen wake lock so your timer never sleeps mid-session

─────────────────────────
✅ TASK MANAGER
─────────────────────────
More than a to-do list. PomoPlan gives you four powerful views to match how you think:

• Kanban Board — move tasks through To Do / In Progress / Done
• Eisenhower Matrix — prioritize by urgency and importance in four quadrants
• Waterfall View — plan tasks with dependencies, step by step
• Calendar View — see all your deadlines at a glance

Plus: subtasks, repeating tasks, priority tags, project lists, smart filters (Today / This Week / Overdue / All), bulk actions, and full-text search across tasks and notes.

─────────────────────────
🔁 HABIT TRACKER
─────────────────────────
• Build streaks with daily, weekday, weekend, or custom schedules
• 12-week grid and 30-day consistency chart
• Track current streak, best streak & total completions

─────────────────────────
📊 STATISTICS & INSIGHTS
─────────────────────────
• Daily, weekly, monthly & yearly productivity reports
• Focus heatmap — spot your most productive hours
• Task completion charts and per-task session breakdowns
• Annual trend view to see your progress over time

─────────────────────────
☁️ SYNC, WIDGETS & MORE
─────────────────────────
• Google Drive cloud backup & one-tap restore
• Home screen widgets: Task list, Monthly calendar & Habits
• Works fully offline — no account required
• Available in 85+ languages

─────────────────────────
🎯 WHO IS IT FOR?
─────────────────────────
Students, remote workers, freelancers, developers, writers — anyone who fights distraction and wants a reliable system to get more done.

Studying for exams? Use the Pomodoro timer to protect your focus blocks
